* 1. addon-config-resources
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: constellation/addon-config-resources
:FILE: src/graphden/system/config.clj
:LINE: 57
:MINS: 1.2

Reads [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addon]] configuration resources from ~GRAPHDEN_ADDON_CONFIGS~. Without them, core runs independently. The public core must not depend on private [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addons]]: tenancy depends on core, and cloud assembly depends on both. This configuration boundary preserves that dependency direction.

* 2. merge-addon
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: constellation/merge-addon
:FILE: src/graphden/system/config.clj
:LINE: 68
:MINS: 1.4
:END:

Loads an [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addon]]'s required namespaces, then merges its configuration over core configuration. Loading registers component implementations before initialization. Cloud and self-hosted deployments assemble the same core with different components rather than maintaining divergent copies. See [[file:../../../docs/PACKAGE_DISTRIBUTION.md][distribution]].

Core call sites depend on this interface rather than private [[file:glossary.org::#term/auth][authorization]] implementation. Platform [[file:glossary.org::#term/auth][capability]] checks have a corresponding installer. See the [[file:../../../docs/TENANCY_SEAM.md][tenancy extension interface]] for default and [[file:glossary.org::#term/integrant][addon]] behavior.

* 6. read-manifest
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: constellation/read-manifest
:FILE: src/graphden/packages/manifest.clj
:LINE: 32
:MINS: 1.1
:END:

Reads the operator manifest of external packages containing code and function definitions. The build includes these libraries in the application artifact, and boot loads their named packages. A name-only entry refers to a package already available on the [[file:glossary.org::#term/edn][classpath]].

Adds manifest dependencies to the build basis. [[file:glossary.org::#term/semver][Pin]] checks ensure the manifest and ~deps.edn~ select the same revisions; copy checks ensure local test copies match available sibling repositories. This keeps tested package content aligned with the shipped artifact.

* 8. -main
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: constellation/-main
:FILE: src/graphden/executor_runtime/core.clj
:LINE: 187
:MINS: 1.2
:END:

Cloud assembly starts the same core ~-main~ rather than supplying another executor. Release checks must keep the core revision used by cloud and by tenancy identical; otherwise the assembled deployment differs from the combination tested. Documentation, translations, and organisation templates live in separate repositories without becoming runtime dependencies.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/executor_runtime/core.clj::(defn -main][src/graphden/executor_runtime/core.clj:187]]
